'''Bamboo''' was a tall, slender, leafy [[Plant/Legends|plant]] found on many worlds. Most species, if not all, thrived in [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-like conditions.

{{Flora-stub}}

==Species==
The following is a list of all known bamboos:

*[[Corulag bamboo]], a type of bamboo which grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]
*[[Hylaian marsh bamboo]], from the [[Hylaia system/Legends|Hylaia system]], found in the [[Room of a Thousand Fountains/Legends|Room of a Thousand Fountains]] during the [[Fall Of The Republic|last]] [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]
*[[Onderonian bamboo]], which [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]
